article.headline: Spurs face the Mavericks on 5-game win streak
article.description: Dallas Mavericks (4-3, ninth in the Western Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (5-2, sixth in the Western Conference)
article.title: Spurs face the Mavericks on 5-game win streak
article.linkText: Spurs face the Mavericks on 5-game win streak
article.story: Dallas Mavericks (4-3, ninth in the Western Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (5-2, sixth in the Western Conference) San Antonio; Wednesday, 9:30 p.m. EST LINE: Spurs -12.5; over/under is 229.5 BOTTOM LINE: San Antonio heads into a matchup against Dallas as winners of five games in a row. San Antonio went 62-20 overall, 13-3 in Southwest Division action and 32-8 at home last season. The Spurs allowed opponents to score 111.5 points per game and shoot 45.1% from the field last season. Dallas finished 26-56 overall and 14-37 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Mavericks averaged 15.9 points off of turnovers, 13.6 second-chance points and 43.3 bench points last season. The teams meet for the second time this season. The Spurs won 122-106 in the last matchup on Oct. 25. INJURIES: Spurs: Jayden Quaintance: out (knee), Tobias Harris: out (calf). Mavericks: Max Christie: out (hip), Santi Aldama: out (knee), Kyrie Irving: out (knee), Tarik Biberovic: out (heel), Sergio De Larrea: out (knee), Dereck Lively II: out (foot). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
